text.zh: 多层次内容使用 Markdown 标题分级，关键术语和结论加粗，独立主题之间使用分隔线。
text.en: Use Markdown headings to level multi-layered content, bold key terms and conclusions, and separate independent topics with horizontal rules.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

purpose.zh: 让层次、重点与主题边界一目了然
purpose.en: Make the levels, the key points and the topic boundaries obvious at a glance

exclude.zh: 单层、简短、无需分级的内容
exclude.en: Single-level, short content that needs no levels
